name: SNZ Southern 2017

venue.name: White Elephant Trust, Christchurch
venue.address: White Elephant Trust, 442 Tuam street,  Christchurch

information: SNZ Southern 2017 is an official WCA sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
